# Invalid fixture cases

The unit tests derive bounded invalid cases from valid text fixtures. Covered failures include missing fields, traversal paths, malformed checksums, unknown provenance, unresolved references, non-approved reviews, mismatched export metadata, invalid preview dimensions, stale scene bindings, modified offline preview files, extra files, escaped or symlinked paths, invalid rational frame rates, discontinuous scene segments, altered frame/span inventories, stale audio-preview bindings, and conflicting render-plan packages. No binary fixture is required.
